contract: Window.postMessage queues a global task on the posted message task source. It does not replace the yield with a Promise microtask.
The receiver checks the exact same Window source, the exact current origin and a unique payload before resolving.
The helper sends only an internal token to its own window, using the exact current origin. It sends no article text, account data or network request.
The exact listener is removed after delivery and after a synchronous postMessage failure. Unsupported environments return null so the existing timer fallback remains available.
The existing processing-task guard runs after this awaited yield, so cancellation and draft-staleness checks retain their current ownership.
nativePerformanceBoundary: The standard establishes the task-source semantics. Actual hidden-window completion and cancellation require separately recorded native browser runs; isolated helper tests alone make no performance claim.
